rows.headline: THE LAST SEASON SETTLES IT

rows.headline: THE LAST CHAPTER LOADS
rows.subhead: Everything written so far now waits on a single closing season, with {leader} in front and {trailer} still very much in the story.

rows.headline: LAST ORDERS, EVERYONE
rows.subhead: One more season remains on the bar, and whoever wins it will walk out with the Showdown in hand.

rows.headline: THE FINAL PAGE TURNS

rows.headline: LAST LAP, LOUD ENGINES

rows.headline: HOLD YOUR NERVE, {leader}
rows.subhead: The advantage is real, yet the closing season is exactly where a lead is tested hardest by a determined rival.

rows.headline: DESTINY COMES KNOCKING

rows.headline: CHASE FOR THE LAST WORD

rows.headline: THE FINAL STRETCH IS NIGH
rows.subhead: Legs are heavy and nerves are tight, but the last season is here and there is only one way to run it.

rows.headline: THE CLOSING MOVEMENT
